cases.scenario: Two providers use Consumer Cyclical and Consumer Discretionary with different rosters.
cases.required_interpretation: Preserve provider namespace and roster dates; do not assume identical membership.

cases.scenario: Revenue rises in a geography while comparable sales fall.
cases.required_interpretation: Show total growth and mature-location demand separately; investigate space, cohort, FX and acquisitions.

cases.scenario: Home Depot consolidated sales include businesses excluded from transaction/ticket metrics.
cases.required_interpretation: Do not label a scoped transaction-times-ticket calculation a full-company revenue bridge.

cases.scenario: Home closings rise while homebuilding pretax income falls.
cases.required_interpretation: Preserve positive activity and negative profit dimensions; test incentives, mix and cost.

cases.scenario: Restaurant average check rises without an item-level price/mix decomposition.
cases.required_interpretation: Do not call the whole change menu-price inflation or pricing power.

cases.scenario: Wholesale brand revenue improves while direct-channel sales decline.
cases.required_interpretation: Do not promote shipments to evidence of end-customer demand or improved total channel economics.

cases.scenario: Inventory dollars remain flat while units rise and mix shifts.
cases.required_interpretation: Retain quantity/mix differences and unknown aging; do not call inventory cleared.

cases.scenario: Reported gross-margin improvement includes a large recovery accrual.
cases.required_interpretation: Keep the reported result and an explicitly reconciled interpretation; do not assign the item to recurring brand demand.

cases.scenario: A refund is accompanied by related incremental compensation.
cases.required_interpretation: Reconcile both income and linked expense; do not subtract the gross benefit alone.

cases.scenario: Nearby August quarters are labeled FY2026 and FY2027 by different issuers.
cases.required_interpretation: Join on actual start/end dates and fiscal definitions, not year labels alone.

cases.scenario: A global brand reports different current- and constant-currency growth.
cases.required_interpretation: Retain both bases and avoid treating currency translation as unit demand.

cases.scenario: A marketplace reports fees alongside first-party gross retail revenue.
cases.required_interpretation: Do not infer comparable merchandise activity or take rates from unlike recognized-revenue lines.

cases.scenario: Bookings in one quarter relate to stays or refunds in later quarters.
cases.required_interpretation: Require matched cohorts or label any revenue/bookings ratio a limited accounting proxy.

cases.scenario: Cruise occupancy exceeds 100% under a two-berth convention.
cases.required_interpretation: Apply the issuer metric definition; do not cap, reject or call the value a data error merely because it exceeds 100%.

cases.scenario: A loan allowance is released when loans move to held for sale.
cases.required_interpretation: Do not interpret the release alone as improved borrower credit performance.

cases.scenario: The next scheduled quarterly earnings release occurs after the research cutoff.
cases.required_interpretation: Keep its numbers unknown; do not use prior-year similarly named results as the new quarter.

cases.scenario: An issuer introduces new segment reporting and recasts history.
cases.required_interpretation: Retain original first-known definitions and recast lineage; do not backdate the new view.

cases.scenario: Retail spending increases in dollars but the source is not price adjusted.
cases.required_interpretation: Do not label the nominal growth a unit-volume increase; preserve product/geographic deflator limits.

cases.scenario: Rates fall but principal, term, fees or approval constraints differ.
cases.required_interpretation: Compute only explicitly specified scenarios and separate payment arithmetic from actual purchasing ability.

cases.scenario: Aggregate household debt or saving data is used to explain one brand.
cases.required_interpretation: Require customer-cohort evidence; do not infer issuer demand from a national mean.

cases.scenario: Expected recovery is recognized before all associated cash is received.
cases.required_interpretation: Maintain recognition and cash timestamps separately; no automatic cash-flow equivalence.

cases.scenario: Travel customer cash is collected before service and can be refundable.
cases.required_interpretation: Separate working capital and refund obligations from earned revenue and durable free cash.

cases.scenario: Operating cash rises while investment leaves free cash negative.
cases.required_interpretation: Preserve capital spending and definition boundaries; do not claim an equity-cash inflection from operating cash alone.

cases.scenario: Systemwide restaurant turnover grows.
cases.required_interpretation: Do not consolidate all franchisee turnover into the listed parent or assume franchisee returns improve.

cases.scenario: An enterprise-value ratio adds lease liabilities but uses an inconsistent earnings basis.
cases.required_interpretation: Flag the mismatch; reconcile financing businesses, leases and minority claims before comparison.

cases.scenario: An earnings denominator is zero or negative.
cases.required_interpretation: Do not generate a standard positive P/E conclusion; require a documented alternative model or abstain.

cases.scenario: ADR, ordinary shares and local listings represent the same underlying issuer economics.
cases.required_interpretation: Use existing issuer/security and corporate-action ownership; do not double-count company exposure.

cases.scenario: Several thematic baskets hold the same large issuer.
cases.required_interpretation: Show overlap/concentration; do not count correlated memberships as independent confirming evidence.

cases.scenario: A historical cyclicals study includes only currently surviving listed companies.
cases.required_interpretation: Require historical delisted/acquired populations or label the bias and withhold an unqualified result.

cases.scenario: A revised estimate or final release repeats information already public.
cases.required_interpretation: Preserve first-known and correction lineage; no backfilled surprise or duplicate independent event.

cases.scenario: A category is labeled a trade-down beneficiary or supplier bottleneck from narrative alone.
cases.required_interpretation: Require affected cohort/resource, contract, dated quantity/quality evidence, substitute, lag and falsifier.

cases.scenario: A persuasive theme explanation or prospective case appears in the research artifact.
cases.required_interpretation: Keep all rank, gate, sizing and trade authority off until separately accepted validation and promotion.
